dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん、起きて〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Wake up, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Wake up, oniichan!"

dialogues.jp:
周りから独立したように、さくらの声がはっき
りと耳にとどく。
dialogues.en: I could hear Sakura's voice clearly.
dialogues.text: I could hear Sakura's voice clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「起きろやこらぁ〜！」
dialogues.en: "Wake up, idiot!"
dialogues.text: "Wake up, idiot!"

dialogues.jp: 色気もなにもない声――。
dialogues.en: No trace of feminineness ----
dialogues.text: No trace of feminineness ----

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……起きないや……」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm...... he's not waking up......"
dialogues.text: "Hmmm...... he's not waking up......"

dialogues.jp:
ぶつくさ｛つぶや／呟｝くさくら。なにを言っているのかは
聞き取れないが、どうせろくなことじゃないだ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
She mumbled to herself. I couldn't hear what she was saying,
but it can't be anything good.
dialogues.text:
She mumbled to herself. I couldn't hear what she was saying,
but it can't be anything good.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、分かった！　これは目覚めのキスをして
　欲しいってことだね」
dialogues.en: "I got it! You need a kiss to wake up."
dialogues.text: "I got it! You need a kiss to wake up."

dialogues.jp: ポンと手をうち、勝手に納得する。
dialogues.en: She seemed to be making some sense to herself.
dialogues.text: She seemed to be making some sense to herself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「にゃははは……しょうがないな、お兄ちゃん
　は」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha...... naughty you."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha...... naughty you."

dialogues.jp: さくらの吐息が唇にかかる。
dialogues.en: I felt her breath on my lips.
dialogues.text: I felt her breath on my lips.

dialogues.jp: さすがはアメリカ――迷わず口づけですか……。
dialogues.en:
She's lived in the United States after all -- straight to
the lips.......
dialogues.text:
She's lived in the United States after all -- straight to
the lips.......

dialogues.jp: さくら――。
dialogues.en: Sakura-----
dialogues.text: Sakura-----

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「……なに、にやけた顔して寝言を言っている
　んですか、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "......What's that smirk on your face?"
dialogues.text: "......What's that smirk on your face?"

dialogues.jp: ギュッ――。
dialogues.en: Pinch-----
dialogues.text: Pinch-----

dialogues.jp: 脇腹をつねられるような痛みに、目が覚める。
dialogues.en: I woke up from a pinch on my side.
dialogues.text: I woke up from a pinch on my side.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「起きましたか、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Are you awake?"
dialogues.text: "Are you awake?"

dialogues.jp: 笑顔を引きつらせ、音夢が横に立っていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu was standing there with a scary smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu was standing there with a scary smile.

dialogues.jp: 「さくらは？」
dialogues.en: "Where's Sakura?"
dialogues.text: "Where's Sakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「自分のクラスだと思いますけど！？」
dialogues.en: "I believe she's in her class!?"
dialogues.text: "I believe she's in her class!?"

dialogues.jp:
眉をピクピクさせながら、見かけ笑顔で答える
音夢。
dialogues.en: Her eyebrows were twitching in anger, but she kept smiling.
dialogues.text: Her eyebrows were twitching in anger, but she kept smiling.

dialogues.en: (----Scary.)
dialogues.text: (----Scary.)

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、私はそろそろ行きますね。兄さんも、
　ご自由にお昼ご飯を食べてくださいまし！」
dialogues.en: "I better get going now. Go and enjoy your lunch!"
dialogues.text: "I better get going now. Go and enjoy your lunch!"

dialogues.jp: 笑顔なのに、寒気を感じた音夢の後姿を見送る。
dialogues.en: I saw her walking away with a scary smile.
dialogues.text: I saw her walking away with a scary smile.

dialogues.jp: 溜め息と一緒に、肩の力をぬいた。
dialogues.en: I relaxed my shoulders as I sighed.
dialogues.text: I relaxed my shoulders as I sighed.

dialogues.jp: 「なんか、散々な目にあったな」
dialogues.en: "That wasn't good."
dialogues.text: "That wasn't good."

dialogues.jp: でも、おかげで昼休みを寝過ごさずにすんだ。
dialogues.en: But, at least I didn't sleep through lunch break.
dialogues.text: But, at least I didn't sleep through lunch break.

dialogues.jp: せっかくだから、昼飯でも食いに行くか……。
dialogues.en: I should go get something to eat......
dialogues.text: I should go get something to eat......

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらの夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dream about Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dream about Sakura◆

dialogues.jp: さくらの夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I had a dream about Sakura.
dialogues.text: I had a dream about Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが、俺を目覚めのキスで起こしてくれる
夢だ……。
dialogues.en: It was a dream about Sakura waking me up nicely.
dialogues.text: It was a dream about Sakura waking me up nicely.
